title: Erdős #1144: Partial Sums of Random Multiplicative Functions

problemStatement.formal: ∀ f, IsRademacherMultiplicative f → ∀ C > 0, ∀ᶠ N in atTop, C * √N ≤ |∑_{m≤N} f(m)|
problemStatement.plain: For a random completely multiplicative function f with f(p) ∈ {-1,1} chosen uniformly for each prime p, does limsup |∑_{m≤N} f(m)| / √N = ∞ hold almost surely?
whyMatters: Fundamental question about fluctuations of multiplicative functions
Connects number theory with probability theory
Atherfold (2025) upper bound creates tension with the conjecture

proven: Proved: rademacher_values_pm1, rademacher_abs_one, completely_mult_zero, trivial bound, pinch theorem
open: Whether limsup |∑ f(m)| / √N = ∞ almost surely (THIS problem)
knownResults.goal: Determine the almost-sure growth rate of partial sums

currentState.nextAction: Problem is OPEN. 1 sorry could be eliminated (atherfold_implies_subpolynomial).

knowledge.progressSummary: FORMALIZED: Full Lean 4 formalization with 1 sorry and 1 axiom. Proved Rademacher multiplicative function properties (values in {-1,1}, |f(n)|=1, f(0)=0). Stated main conjecture in deterministic and probabilistic forms. Proved trivial bound and conjecture-Atherfold pinch theorem.
insights: Problem is OPEN - Atherfold (2025) gave upper bound but conjecture remains unresolved
Atherfold bound (√N · (log N)^{1+o(1)}) creates tension: if true, growth is between √N and √N·polylog
Constant function f≡1 is a deterministic counterexample (linear growth) - conjecture is probabilistic
Formalization cleanly separates deterministic properties from probabilistic conjecture
nextSteps: The 1 sorry (atherfold_implies_subpolynomial) could be proved from atherfold_upper_bound
Problem is OPEN - main conjecture cannot be resolved
